activation: Authorized conditional expansion after analysis; register an independent next-version selection, manifest, capacity estimate and matched controls before execution. No blanket accuracy cutoff.
requires: same-dev training-size curves with actual train counts
error analysis distinguishes data limitation from labeling/preprocessing bugs
official per-cell availability and source labels
all current sample split/group/label/hash anchors preserved
new-group hash allocation, no old singleton-floor bias
matched 100/cell control if introducing class weights
sequence: Analyze 100; expand to 200 only with documented data-limitation rationale; evaluate 200 before deciding 500.
holdout: Never move, score, or tune existing holdout; metadata/integrity only.
